deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout r-roll-2034: model=rw-v2-q4, route=text-generation-v2, target=15% across [us-west-2, eu-west-1]
sam: seeing p99 spikes in eu-west around 14:12 UTC — p99 120ms -> 410ms on 512+ token requests :warning:
maria: can you paste the dashboard link and one sample trace?
sam: dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/latency/text-gen?from=2034567600&to=2034568120
sam: sample trace id: trace-9a2f (long seq, stall at attention kernel)
olivia: if p99 > 300ms sustained for 5m we should stop and pin to rw-v2-stable (non-quant). prefer safe stop over risking customer impact
sam: also seeing 5xx rate tick from 0.2% -> 0.9% on the embeddings subroute concurrently
aaron: recommendation: pause rollout, pin route to stable model, and run targeted perf job to reproduce
maria: agree. I'll prep release-note blurb and update change window owners
sam: executing pause now
sam: `redwoodctl rollout pause --id r-roll-2034 --route text-generation-v2 --reason "latency spike"`
deploy-bot: Rollout r-roll-2034 paused by sam at 2034568002. traffic percent -> 0% :white_check_mark:
olivia: next: pin production to rw-v2-stable until we baseline q4 variances
sam: `redwoodctl release pin --route text-generation-v2 --version rw-v2-stable --note "pin after latency spike"`
deploy-bot: Release pinned: route=text-generation-v2 -> rw-v2-stable by sam at 2034568018
will: I'll kick off an eval comparing rw-v2-q4 vs rw-v2-stable on 512/1024 token profiles and attach results
aaron: create INC-2034 P1, link to rollout artifacts and playbook https://playbooks.redwood.ai/rollout-runbook
maria: action items: (1) update release notes + rollback steps, (2) file perf regression ticket, (3) schedule repro change window
olivia: scheduling 1h change window tomorrow 15:00 UTC to repro + limited canary (owners: olivia, will)
maria: include cost delta, latency delta, and kv-cache hit metrics in notes
sam: copying logs and traces to artifacts bucket -> s3://redwood-artifacts/rollouts/r-roll-2034/
maria: filing follow-up PR to disable auto-quant q4 for this route until we finish RCA
deploy-bot: Automated snapshot produced: http://artifacts.local/rollout-2034/snapshot.json
will: will run targeted kernel profiler during change window, posting results here
aaron: once we have profiler + eval, we can decide to resume gradual rollout or keep stable pin
maria: I'll own the postmortem draft after RCA. tagging for next ops review :eyes:
sam: monitoring sigs, will ping when metrics return to baseline :thumbsup:
maria: thanks everyone, closing this checkpoint. re-open if anything else crops up
